intro.text: The southern Scadrians' name for Ruin and Preservation together: Herr and his sister and wife Frue, at once united and apart.

description.text: Herr is seen as a force of motion and Frue as a force of stillness. Neither can make life alone.
The southern Scadrians hold that the kings of old, whom they now call the Fallen, angered the Jaggenmire and so caused the Ice Death.
